title: Aromatic Saudi Water Chestnut Tagine
description: A citrusy, molten tagine that acts as a hangover cure, featuring water chestnuts simmered in kombu cold extract.
instructions: Heat a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat and add olive oil, then sauté the cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the drained water chestnuts and stir to coat them with the spice mixture, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in the kombu cold extract, orange juice, and lemon juice, then add the orange and lemon zest.
Stir in the salt and pepper, letting the liquids come to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the tagine simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After 45 minutes, remove the lid and simmer for another 15 minutes until the liquid reduces to a thick, molten consistency.
Stir in the chopped cilantro during the last five minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if needed.
Serve hot, spooning the aromatic mixture into bowls and garnishing with extra cilantro.
